title: Smokemont Riding Stables

services.name: Trail ride
services.desc: River Crossing Trail Explore the beauty of the Great Smoky Mountains on our Hourly Rides. Ford the Oconaluftee River, traverse a tunnel beneath US 441, and embark on a scenic 3-mile loop through the mountains. Don’t miss this opportunity to connect with nature. Departure Times: Every hour from 9:30 am - 3:30 pm
